OUR STORY

Cigala Cycling Tours was born from a simple idea: to share the joy of discovering the world by bike, guided by real experience, passion, and the highest level of professionalism.

Our founder, Matteo Cigala, spent years racing at professional and elite level across Europe. As very successful coach, he works with riders of all abilities — from beginners building their first structured training plan to pros riding the biggest races in the world.

Through his coaching business, he learned something valuable: people don’t just want to ride. They want to experience. They want connection, challenge, culture, and a sense of achievement.

After years spent leading training camps, Matteo realised something powerful: the best rides were never about the distance or the speed —they were about the moments. The quiet beauty of a road chosen with intention. The conversation that carries you up a climb. The beautiful coffee stop and the chosen local restaurants. The pride and joy that blooms at a summit earned together.

He wanted to bring that feeling to every cyclist. So he created tours shaped with purpose and crafted with care—no generic routes, no crowded groups, no touristy shortcuts. Just authentic, deeply personal adventures designed for riders who crave connection, meaning, and the kind of experiences that stay with you long after the journey ends.

What began as a passion project quickly grew into a dedicated premium tour company. Drawing on his racing background, local knowledge, and coaching expertise, Matteo crafted tours that balance performance and pleasure: challenging but achievable, supported yet adventurous, social yet personal.

Today, after more than 10 years running tours, Cigala Cycling Tours welcomes riders from around the world to explore Europe’s most iconic and hidden cycling destinations.

Each tour reflects Matteo’s standards — small groups, handcrafted routes, professional atmosphere, exceptional organisation, and the belief that cycling is one of the best ways to experience a place.

Our mission is simple: create memorable adventures while meeting new friends, sharing the same passion that leaves you a lifetime experience.

Our story is still being written, one climb, one ride, and one unforgettable journey at a time.

WHY RIDERS CHOOSE US

✔ Expertise You Can Trust
Our staff are all former pro or semi pro cyclists with knowledge and thousands of hours guiding on European roads.

✔ 10+ Years of Tour Experience
A decade of crafting smooth, safe, high-quality cycling tours.

✔ Hand-Built Routes
Every climb and descent is selected through first-hand experience — never guesswork.

✔ Premium, Personal Support
Small groups, on-road vehicle & mechanical assistance, detailed briefings, professional ride leaders.

✔ The Perfect Balance
Challenging riding, great food, beautiful accommodation, and a relaxed post-ride atmosphere.

✔ All Levels Welcome
We support each rider at their pace, ensuring everyone enjoys the experience without pressure.
